The '''Sil'Lume asteroid belt''' was an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] located in the [[Seitia sector/Legends|Seitia sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==Description==
Over 800,000 of the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] were cataloged and claimed for [[Mining/Legends|mining]] or other operations, including [[24 Tredway]], [[40,005 Milton]], and [[400,324 Henryson]].<ref name="JH" />

==History==
During the [[Yavin blockade]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] went to the Sil'Lume asteroid belt to scout its potential as a new [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] base.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
